definition: John McCarthy is known for coining the term 'Artificial Intelligence' and inventing Lisp.
details: Organized the 1956 Dartmouth Workshop that founded AI as an academic discipline and developed the Lisp programming language.

explainer.lead: John McCarthy was an American computer scientist and cognitive scientist (1927-2011). His work spans artificial intelligence.
explainer.knownFor: Notable works include artificial intelligence and Colossal Typewriter.
